notes: Auto reconnect fixed + the updater can no longer stall silently
patch_notes:
Auto mode reconnect fix: after a game session, reconnecting failed with 'window was not found' because the app grabbed the wrong Proton window. It now finds Proton's real main window (the one with the actual controls), surfaces it if it is hidden or minimized, and waits longer before giving up.
Updater hardening: the update helper now writes its progress into update_build.log from the very first step, and if old copies of the app are still running after about a minute it closes them and carries on — an update can no longer wait forever in silence.
